```{r}
#| include: false
data_dir <- here("01_data")
```

```{r}
load(here(data_dir, "analysis", "df_wide.RData"))
df <- df_wide 
rm(df_wide)
```

## Select Random Sample for Coding

```{r}
set.seed(123) 

validation_sample <- df |>
  group_by(exp_condition) |>
  slice_sample(n = 70) |>
  ungroup() |>
  slice_sample(prop = 1) |> 
  select(id, exp_comment)
```

Save for manual coding (not evaluated on render, so the coded sample is not overwritten):

```{r}
#| eval: false
write_csv(validation_sample, here(data_dir, "validation", "validation_sample.csv"))
```

## Load Coded Data

```{r}
coded_sample <- read_excel(here(data_dir, "validation", "validation_sample.xlsx"))
```

## IRR, Correlations, and Differences

Join the data:

```{r}
validation_df <- coded_sample |> 
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) |> 
  left_join(df |> select(id, exp_comment_sentiment, anxiety_hope_dim, exp_condition), by = "id")
```

Correlations between the human coding, the LLM coding, and the self-reported anxiety–hope dimension:

```{r}
validation_df |>
  count(human_na = is.na(exp_comment_sentiment_validation),
        llm_na = is.na(exp_comment_sentiment))

validation_df |>
  drop_na(exp_comment_sentiment, exp_comment_sentiment_validation) |>
  select(exp_comment_sentiment, exp_comment_sentiment_validation, anxiety_hope_dim) |>
  correlation()
```

Intraclass correlation:

```{r}
validation_df |>
  drop_na(exp_comment_sentiment, exp_comment_sentiment_validation) |>
  select(exp_comment_sentiment_validation, exp_comment_sentiment) |>
  icc(model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "single")
```

Differences between conditions and raters:

```{r}
validation_long <- validation_df |>
  drop_na(exp_comment_sentiment, exp_comment_sentiment_validation) |>
  pivot_longer(c(exp_comment_sentiment, exp_comment_sentiment_validation),
               names_to = "rater", values_to = "sentiment") |>
  mutate(rater = if_else(rater == "exp_comment_sentiment", "LLM", "Human"))

validation_long |>
  group_by(exp_condition, rater) |>
  summarise(m = mean(sentiment), sd = sd(sentiment), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

validation_long |>
  anova_test(dv = sentiment, wid = id, between = exp_condition, within = rater)
```
